verdict.rationale: Edge0 is built as a local inference engine. Weights are streamed from local SSD, the server binds to 127.0.0.1 with an OpenAI-compatible API, and there are dedicated on-device apps and engines for iOS, Android, Windows and macOS, so prompts are processed on the user's own hardware. The core of the story is clearly delivered, but the evidence never explicitly confirms that no data leaves the device. Missing for 10: an explicit no-telemetry/offline-operation guarantee, independent or hands-on corroboration that no data leaves the device.
